/platform/hosts/finder: Machine Finder: opens the fleet VM list in its topology lens (/platform/vms?lens=topology) to find any VM by host, network or name.
/platform/alert-rules: Threshold alert rules on VM CPU and memory: notify (via Alerts / webhooks) when a metric crosses a bound.
/platform/scheduled-jobs: Recurring controller operations from a whitelist, for example periodic host inventory refresh.
/platform/zyra/security/native-bpf: Native eBPF: per-host machina-bpfd status, observe/enforce mode under a lease, deny/allow policies, flows, DNS, L7, load balancing, CNI and guest policy across 22 tabs.
/platform/backup-replication: Backup Replication — copy completed backups to an S3-compatible store at another site, see which copies are verified, and fetch one back onto a host. Page at `/platform/backup-replication`.
/platform/failure-domains: Failure Domains — racks defined by host site and rack labels, and whether HA could re-home each rack if it were lost. Page at `/platform/failure-domains`.
/platform/k8s-clusters: Kubernetes Clusters — create, scale, upgrade and delete k3s clusters across enrolled hosts (opt-in on the controller and each host). Page at `/platform/k8s-clusters`.
/platform/desktop-pools: Desktop Pools — clone a template VM into numbered desktops, check one out per user and recycle it on release. Page at `/platform/desktop-pools`.
/platform/migration-waves: Migration Waves — plan a batch of VMs for Transiva, start them a few at a time, follow each job and record cutover. Page at `/platform/migration-waves`.
